messages:
Alex K: OK team — booking a private/VPC deploy window for customer 'Summit' next Tue 03:00 UTC. Who can lead? We need lead, smoke, rollback owner, and DB sign-off.
Maria V: I can lead the deploy. PR #482 is merged and Maria V: approved by @Sri P earlier.
Sri P: LGTM on the PR, only a small env var tweak (SUMMIT_FEATURE_FLAG) — tested locally.
Jamie L: I’ll own smoke tests + canary traffic. Will run the checklist and share results in this thread.
Alex K: Thanks. Quick checklist I want confirmed before T-1h:
- PR merged & tag created
- Canary route ready
- Snapshot taken of DB
- Rollback image available
Maria V: All items except snapshot are green. Infra, can you confirm DB snapshot will be taken at T-30m? @Sri P you ok with migration being reversible?
Sri P: Migration is reversible (we added a down migration). Confirmed.
Deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z - 2026-03-24T03:45:00Z for customer summit (owner: Maria V).
Jamie L: Smoke test plan (short):
```
1) curl -sS https://summit-api.internal/health || exit 1
2) run smoke-suite --env=staging --subset=canary
3) verify embeddings endpoint returns 200 for sample prompt
```
I’ll post failures as inline logs.
Alex K: Rollback plan summary (Maria pls confirm):
- If post-deploy errors > 5% for 10m, revert traffic to previous instance set
- Deploy team runs `kubectl rollout undo` to image tag `summit-v2.3.1`
- DB down-migrate if schema issues detected (manual, needs Sri)
Maria V: Confirmed. I’ve created the runbook snippet under /runbooks/summit/vpc-deploy.md and set `summit-v2.4.0-rc` as target tag.
Jamie L: Can someone ping QA to stand by at T-10m? @QA-team (cc @maria)
Alex K: Pinged QA in #support (they acknowledged). :thumbsup:
Sri P: FYI I’ll be on-call during the window and reachable on phone.
Maria V: Final ask — can infra ensure the private ECR has `summit-v2.3.1` and `summit-v2.4.0-rc` retained for 72h after deploy?
Deploy-bot: Infra snapshot job scheduled at 2026-03-24T02:30:00Z (T-30m). Notify `eng-oncall` on completion.
Alex K: Great. Plan looks good. I’ll start a brief preflight T-2h thread with exact run commands and expected logs. If anything else, drop it here. :white_check_mark:
Jamie L: I'll prepare a quick smoke checklist doc and leave a link here before EOD.
Maria V: Thanks all — see you for the 03:00 UTC window.
